name: KaliGPT
description: Command-line AI assistant for Kali with several model providers, aimed at students
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: User agent of KaliGPT's web_request_analysis and get_raw_response tools, which the model calls against target URLs (any method and body, redirects followed; web_request_analysis grades security headers, cookies, CORS and caching). Set with setdefault, so a User-Agent the model passes in headers replaces it
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the KaliGPT source code

indicators.context: User agent of KaliGPT's get_local_server_content tool (GET, then page text extraction). Meant for local servers, callable with any URL. Short generic name: other scrapers may use it
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the KaliGPT source code

indicators.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/100.0.4896.127 Safari/537.36
indicators.context: Fixed browser user agent KaliGPT's search tool uses to download the top search results (newspaper3k) for its RAG step. Old Chrome 100 string used by much other software: context only
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the KaliGPT source code

indicators.context: The author's custom GPT, opened in a browser (chromium by default) by kaligpt --web with ?prompt=<operator prompt>. Seen in process command lines and in proxy logs with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the KaliGPT source code

indicators.context: KaliGPT install command (curl -sL ... | bash), which then downloads installers/installer.deb.sh, installer.arch.sh or installer.termux.sh from the same branch as ./kaligptinstaller.sh
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the KaliGPT source code

indicators.context: Companion search helper the KaliGPT installer clones into /opt/KaliGPT/OpenSearchAPI (Flask app on 127.0.0.1:5000 that scrapes Google with nodriver/chromium on Xvfb, Bing and DuckDuckGo). Also cloned by people who use it alone
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the KaliGPT source code

indicators.context: KaliGPT provider configuration with Gemini, OpenAI and OpenRouter API keys and the Ollama URL in clear text; the installer runs chmod 666 on it
